description: List the template packs bundled with this deployment, ranked for the organization: packs covering one of its practice jurisdictions first, then jurisdiction-agnostic packs, then the rest, with packs in the caller's language ahead within each group. Each pack carries its attribution, license, jurisdictions, languages, template list and how many of its templates are already installed. Also reports whether the organization hides pack offers and whether the caller may install.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page

locale.description: BCP-47 tag of the caller's interface language; packs in that language rank first. Use a BCP-47 language tag, for example "cs" or "en-GB".
